name: @c0mpute/worker
description: Native CLI worker for the c0mpute.ai distributed inference network. Runs LLM inference via ollama and connects to the orchestrator via Socket.io.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (process.env.C0MPUTE_BETANET_GOLIVE !== '1') { console.error('BLOCKED: this tree is the betanet worker (3.x) and publishes only at the coordinated go-live with C0MPUTE_BETANET_GOLIVE=1. Classic (live network) releases publish from the release/worker-classic branch as 2.8.x.'); process.exit(1); }"
